verdict.rationale: Pandoc documents reading and writing Word docx, reading Excel spreadsheets, and producing PDF through external engines such as LaTeX, wkhtmltopdf, or weasyprint. Community users confirm practical Word conversions, but also report slow Word handling, broken tables in PDF output, and limited docx layout control (title pages, table autofit). Missing for 10: any evidence of PowerPoint input or output, Excel output (only input is listed), and native PDF conversion that doesn't rely on an external engine without table or Unicode problems.
